answers.reasoning: Camera acquires the image as the eye; algorithms perform the interpretive brain role.
The diagram separates feature/edge measurements from semantic identity; recognition is not solved by calibration or edges alone.
Line labeling infers 3D structure from drawings; pictorial structures model flexible arrangements of parts.
Pyramids represent multiple resolutions; regularization supplies smoothness constraints to ill-posed estimation.
The historical column labels MRFs as probabilistic global optimization, unlike deterministic pyramids or motion recovery.
SfM reconstructs geometry, computational photography includes HDR/panoramas, and deep learning learns representations; the timeline is not exact invention dates.
E(lambda) varies over wavelength; wavelength-selective absorption changes relative strengths rather than necessarily multiplying every band equally.
At a wavelength with R=0, L=E*0=0 for any finite incident E; receptor sensitivity is a later stage.
The source contrasts rod sensitivity/intensity at night with cone daylight color.
Per-wavelength density needs a wavelength unit; radiance versus irradiance additionally requires an angular convention. Reflectance remains dimensionless.
A linear map from more than three spectral degrees of freedom to three outputs is generally non-injective; normalized sensitivity peaks do not restore information.
Tristimulus components are integrated L(lambda)*M_i(lambda) responses, not peak positions/heights or fixed material constants.
Photosites are physical light-sensitive silicon elements generating electrical signals, distinct from filters, lenslets and reconstructed RGB arrays.
CCD shifts charge toward shared conversion; CMOS diagram places conversion at sites with addressed readout.
Both sensor types generate electrical image signals; their specific readout architectures differ and demosaicing is subsequent processing.
CMOS expands to complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor. This spelling correction does not reverse the separately described CCD/CMOS paths.
Analog gain scales already-sensed electrical signals before ADC; it cannot create photons or selectively remove shot noise.
Shot noise is photon-count variability; dark current comes from thermal electrons. Readout and ADC errors are different mechanisms.
Denoising directly suppresses random fluctuations; white balance, color mapping and sharpening have different objectives.
Edge contrast can increase without reconstructing lost information, and high-frequency noise may also be amplified.
A full color matrix can mix channels to a target space, unlike diagonal white-balance gains or spatial demosaicing.
Gamma changes intensity encoding; compression reduces data representation. They are separate pipeline stages.
The physical sensor is behind the optical system while the front plane is a geometric virtual construction.
The normal is perpendicular to the surface, not tangent, illumination or viewing ray.
Straight rays cross at the pinhole and invert the image on the rear plane; the aperture need not refract or reflect.
A larger lens aperture gathers more light while focusing suitable rays; it does not remove object-distance dependence.
A virtual-image extension needs one coherent signed-distance convention; absolute-distance real-image equations are insufficient.
Continuous projections remain meaningful; integer indexing may require later rounding, never before homogeneous division.
A caller without SE3 gets NameError when evaluating SE3.Tx; dependencies imported in another module do not automatically bind caller globals.
Python assignment rebinds camera to the new object; subsequent method calls use its calibration, not stale state attached to a variable name.
f and rho are physical lengths; f/rho gives pixel focal length. imagesize and pp are pixel counts/locations.
Bounds and positive depth test frustum eligibility, not which surface is nearest on a ray.
Oblique grid points have differing camera Z, hence x=fX/Z and y=fY/Z use differing scale factors.
A direction with d_Z nonzero has finite vanishing point (f_x d_X/d_Z+u0,f_y d_Y/d_Z+v0); d_Z=0 is at infinity for nondegenerate projections.
The explicit center fixes X=−0.1,0,+0.1 at Z=1; u=1500X+640 gives490,640,790 pixels.
The first mkgrid invocation precedes the shown import. camera and SE3 also need existing bindings; later imports do not retroactively execute a failed call.
The supplied API condition says pose is call-local, so later no-pose projection uses unchanged stored camera.pose.
mkcube edge coordinates are projected by the camera as wireframe; no filled-surface occlusion solver is implied.
Prism dispersion separates incident wavelength components by angle; it does not create wavelengths or use absorption alone.
CFA sites collect wavelength-selective samples; they do not individually measure all RGB channels or an entire spectrum.
Ideal pinhole geometry has no adjustable refractive focus, while real aperture size affects light and sharpness, including finite-aperture/diffraction limits.
The source compares the crystalline lens with compound camera lenses; it is not an exhaustive anatomical eye model.
Divide each homogeneous vector by its final nonzero component. (2,1,1) and (−4,−2,−2) both give(2,1); other options do not.

The plotted red-brick weighted L area is largest. Equal normalized sensitivity peaks on p932 do not imply equal integrals after weighting by the illumination/material spectrum; p933 explicitly confirms L dominance.
